macros.name: tkzEraseLuaObj
macros.doc: Removes a stored Lua object from the global storage table (typically z, L, C, CO, etc., depending on your conventions).

macros.name: tkzGetNodes
macros.doc: A crucial component in the tikzpicture environment is the macro \tkzGetNodes. This macro transfers the points defined in Lua to TikZ by creating the corresponding nodes.

macros.name: tkzGetNodesMP

macros.name: tkzGetPointFromPath
macros.doc: This macro extracts the i-th vertex of a Lua path and defines it as a TikZ point with a given name.

macros.name: tkzGetPointsFromPath
macros.doc: This macro defines TikZ points from a Lua path.

macros.name: tkzPathCount
macros.doc: This macro retrieves the number of vertices in a Lua path and stores the result in a TeX macro.

macros.name: tkzPrintNumber
macros.doc: This macro formats and prints a number using PGF’s fixed-point output, with a default precision of 2 decimal places.
